members.title: Members and roles
members.intro: Invite members, grant or revoke roles, and deactivate members. Every change is kept in the history. Roles never give approval authority; that comes from the DOA.
members.forbidden: This page is for organization admins. If you need it, ask your organization admin.
members.invited: An invitation was sent to {email}. The link works for 72 hours.
members.importIntro: Download the template, fill it in from row 3 as the Guide sheet explains, then import it. If any row is wrong, nothing is saved and every row to fix is listed.
members.imported: {count, plural, one {# member was imported} other {# members were imported}} and every invitation e-mail was sent.
members.importErrors: Nothing was saved. Fix these rows and import again.
members.deactivateHint: Signs them out on every device and cancels their invitation links at once. Their history and documents stay.
members.deactivateConfirm: I confirm I want to deactivate this member
members.resetHint: The member is signed out on every device at once and sets up the authenticator app again at their next sign-in.

importReasons.UNKNOWN_ROLE: Unknown role. Use a role code or name from the Guide sheet of the template; separate several roles with commas.
importReasons.DUPLICATE_IN_FILE: Same as another row in the file
importReasons.EMPLOYEE_CODE_TAKEN: This employee code is already used
importReasons.NO_ROWS: The file has no data from row 3
importReasons.TOO_MANY_ROWS: More than 500 rows; split the file and import one part at a time
importReasons.UNREADABLE: The file cannot be read; use the template from the download button
importReasons.MISSING_HEADER: Row 1 must hold the column codes of the template. Do not delete or change it: download the template again and paste your data into it.

errors.SELF_GRANT: You cannot grant a role to yourself. Ask another admin to do it.
errors.LAST_ORG_ADMIN: The organization needs at least one admin. Add a new admin first.
errors.ALREADY_GRANTED: The member already has this role.
errors.ALREADY_MEMBER: This e-mail is already a member.
errors.SELF: You cannot do this to your own account. Ask another admin.
errors.SHARED_IDENTITY: This account is also used for another organization and cannot be reset here. Contact the BCS team.
errors.REASON: Enter a reason of at least 3 characters.
errors.INPUT: Some fields are missing or wrong. Check them and try again.
errors.FORBIDDEN: You are not allowed to do this.
errors.FAILED: This could not be saved. Try again.
errors.EMAIL: Enter a valid e-mail, for example name@company.co.th.
errors.NAME: Enter the display name (Thai).
errors.NOT_FOUND: This member is not in the organization. Reload the page and try again.
errors.STATE: The member's status has changed. Reload the page and try again.
errors.BUSY: Another change to this member is being saved. Try again in a moment.
errors.FILE_MISSING: Choose the filled-in Excel file first.
errors.FILE_TOO_LARGE: The file is larger than 900 KB. Split it and import one part at a time.
errors.ROLE_NOT_HELD: The member no longer has this role. Reload the page to see the current roles.
errors.UNAUTHENTICATED: Your session has ended. Sign in again, then do this again.
errors.CONFLICT: This was already sent with different details. Reload the page and try again.
errors.INTERNAL: Something went wrong (reference {requestId}). Try again; if it keeps happening, give this reference to the BCS team.

members.rolesHint: Roles decide the menus and work a member can do. They never give approval authority; that comes from the DOA.
members.noRolesHeld: No roles yet. The member works as a requester.
members.resendHint: The old link stops working at once and a new link, valid for 72 hours, is sent.
members.resetDone: Two-step verification was reset. The member was signed out on every device and will be told.
members.deactivatedNotice: Member deactivated. They can no longer sign in; their history and documents stay.
members.invitedNotSent: The invitation for {email} was saved, but the e-mail could not be sent. Choose Send a new invitation by e-mail on this member's page to send it again.
members.invitedAlready: The invitation for {email} was already saved by an earlier click. No second e-mail was sent.
members.importedNotSent: {count, plural, one {# member was imported} other {# members were imported}}; {sent} of the invitation e-mails were sent. Not sent yet: {emails}. Open these members' pages and choose Send a new invitation by e-mail.
members.importedAlready: This file was already imported ({count, plural, one {# member} other {# members}}). Nothing changed and no e-mail was sent again.
members.revokeSelfConfirm: I understand that once I remove my own {role} role, only another organization admin can give it back
members.resetConfirm: I understand the member is signed out on every device and must set up the authenticator app again

template.line1: Fill in the Members sheet from row 3, one member per row.
template.line2: Do not delete or change row 1 (column codes): the import finds the columns by it. Row 2 describes the columns.
template.line3: Roles column: a role code or name from the table below; separate several roles with commas. Leave it empty for a requester.
template.line4: If any row is wrong, nothing is saved and every row to fix is listed.
template.rolesColumn: Roles (code or name, separated by commas; see the Guide sheet)

modules.title: Enabled modules
modules.intro: Modules are switched on and off by the BCS team according to your contract. This page shows their state, and the organization admins will be told every time one changes.
modules.forbidden: This page is for organization admins. If you need it, ask your organization admin.
